item.title: Fine in February, record highs set
item.description: Record highs were set in Joplin and Vichy on Monday, with temperatures reaching 77°, while other reporting sites were only a few degrees off the record high, and the overall pattern is expected to remain mild for February.

item.title: Cold front Tuesday to sweep out the record warmth
item.description: After a deep freeze, temperatures have quickly risen to record highs, but a cold front is expected to bring cooler temperatures and a storm system with rain and wind is expected to follow.
